title: Case REQ-20261103-LIF001 — underwriting decision
content:
Underwriting summary prepared by the Underwriting Agent for Uma (Underwriting & New Business) for Priya Natarajan (CL-104582), case REQ-20261103-LIF001. Insurer: Corella Life.

Before any health question, Uma's agent explained the duty to take reasonable care in plain English — answer every question carefully, including the asthma and the 2023 back strain, because it protects a claim later — and told Priya she doesn't need to disclose genetic test results, which insurers can't ask for or use from 8 Oct 2026 (see 'Underwriting and the duty to take reasonable care').

Requirements for Priya's age (34) and sums insured: a tele-interview only (Corella's thresholds — see 'Directory — insurers on the approved product list').
Timeline: Authority to Proceed signed Sat 7 Nov 2026 → application lodged with Corella Life Mon 9 Nov → tele-interview Tue 10 Nov → decision Mon 16 Nov 2026.

Decision:
• Life $750,000 — standard rates
• TPD $600,000 (any occupation inside super) and the own-occupation extension — standard rates
• Trauma $150,000 — standard rates
• Asthma — accepted at standard rates
• Income protection $6,125 a month — accepted with an exclusion for back and spine conditions. Corella will review the exclusion after two symptom-free years.

What the exclusion means: income protection won't pay for time off work caused by a back or spine condition, but it still covers other illnesses and injuries. After two symptom-free years, Priya can ask Corella Life to review it.

Acceptance: Priya accepted the exclusion with Amelia on Tue 17 Nov 2026 — accepting an exclusion is a human decision.
Policy: CR-26118204, in force from Wed 18 Nov 2026. Year-1 premium $3,180 (stepped): $858 inside super and $2,322 outside super.
Cooling-off: 14 days, from the earlier of receiving Corella's confirmation and the end of the fifth business day after issue; it ends if a claim is made (Corporations Act s1019B).
Existing cover: Priya told Kestrel Retail Super to keep her $50,000 cover before 30 Nov 2026, so it was kept until the new cover started. Any decision about it now is Priya's, with Amelia.
Financial Crime: driver licence and payslip legitimate; KYC complete; no PEP or sanctions match.
Communications: Cara's welcome letter and plain-English policy summary to Priya; an update to Hannah Lewis that Priya's cover is in place, with no health details (Priya agreed to share the outcome only).

Outcome: ✅ Completed — covered from 18 Nov 2026: life $750,000, TPD $600,000, trauma $150,000 and income protection of $6,125 a month, with a back and spine exclusion on income protection; the old super cover was kept until the new cover started.
